name: Supermicro
outlook:
What Supermicro says to expect

  • Second quarter fiscal 2027: net sales and earnings per shareThe Company expects net sales in the range of $19.5 billion and $21.5 billion for the second quarter of fiscal year 2027 ending December 31, 2026, GAAP net income per diluted share of $1.59 to $1.83 and non-GAAP net income per diluted share of $1.66 to $1.90.
  • Fiscal year 2027: net salesFor fiscal year 2027, the Company expects net sales in the range of $72.0 billion to $82.0 billion.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 3, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
